## Featured Work

- FormMate AI: FormMate started from a small annoyance: retyping the same personal details into every application form on the internet. Paste the form's URL, talk through your information out loud or in text, and it drafts the answers. Nothing goes in until you've looked at it. Review-first was deliberate, not a limitation, since the moment a form-filler can submit without you checking, it stops being a productivity tool and starts being a spam tool. Tech/focus: typescript, ai, voice, automation. repo: https://github.com/iice257/FormMate | live: https://form-mate-ai.vercel.app
- PasteVault: I got tired of messaging myself snippets of text just to move them from laptop to phone. PasteVault is what came out of that: an installable, searchable vault for text, code, links, and JSON that lives across devices without routing through a chat thread you weren't using for that. Tech/focus: javascript, pwa, productivity, clipboard. repo: https://github.com/iice257/PasteVault | live: https://pastevault-lime.vercel.app
- AI Agent Skills: AI Agent Skills isn't one product. It's the toolkit that came out of noticing I was solving the same handful of problems every time I started a new AI-assisted task: research, parsing, publishing, updating. It sits next to a few sibling repos that make up a small personal automation stack. Tech/focus: python, codex, agents, automation. repo: https://github.com/iice257/Skills-quickstarter | live: https://skills-quickstarter.vercel.app
- Restore AI: Restore AI is a mobile concept for the moment you're trying to save a damaged or low-resolution photo that actually matters to someone: restoring, upscaling, recoloring, and resizing it without stitching together five different apps. Tech/focus: mobile, ai image, restoration, ux. repo: https://github.com/iice257/RestoreAI

## Major Project Signals

- PORGE: A private Shopify fashion store I rescued from a terrible inherited build, redesigned to the pixel, and turned into a style documentary. Tech/focus: shopify, next.js, design system, client work. repo: https://github.com/iice257/PORGE | live: https://porge.vercel.app
- Bountic: A bounty board that pays USDC for finishing what an agent started. Tech/focus: crypto, agents, open source. repo: https://github.com/iice257/bountic | live: https://bountic.vercel.app
- Loop Monitor: The dashboard I built so I'd stop guessing what my agents were actually doing. Tech/focus: dashboard, agents, ops. repo: https://github.com/iice257/loop-monitor
- Rustchain: A DePIN network where the only requirement for hardware is that it's old. Tech/focus: blockchain, depin, hardware. repo: https://github.com/iice257/Rustchain | live: https://rustchain.org
- Pages Forward: The second, better version of a bookstore I'd already built once. Tech/focus: javascript, commerce, frontend, content. repo: https://github.com/iice257/Pages-forward-rebuild
- SignalOps: A security triage cockpit for the part of the job that's mostly scanning and deciding. Tech/focus: typescript, security, ops. repo: https://github.com/iice257/signalops | live: https://signalops-orpin.vercel.app
- Agent iMessage Handoff: One shared relay and three harness bridges so Codex and opencode sessions continue from your phone. Tech/focus: typescript, cloudflare workers, imessage, agents. repo: https://github.com/iice257/agent-imessage-handoff
- Unfollowr: Follow-list cleanup that scores instead of guessing. Tech/focus: typescript, dashboard, social. repo: https://github.com/iice257/Unfollowr
